vulnerability.title: Stale Price Acceptance & Zero / Negative Value Oracle Exploits
vulnerability.category: Decentralized Oracle Feed & L2 Sequencer Uptime
vulnerability.rootCause: Consuming protocols ignoring updatedAt timestamp thresholds and minAnswer / maxAnswer circuit breaker bounds.
vulnerability.attackVector: LUNA-style death spiral or flash market crash reaches circuit breaker minAnswer ($0.10); feed returns static price while market trades at $0.001.
